posts.zh:
dsh-web-restart 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DSH Web 界面一键重启按钮：侧边栏底部按钮，单击即重启 dsh web 进程，且重启后按钮常驻。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-fbef6af540b5710ba3fd.html
posts.en:
dsh-web-restart is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. One-click restart button for the DSH Web UI: a sidebar footer button that restarts the dsh web process with a single click and persists across the restart it triggers.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-fbef6af540b5710ba3fd.html
